##### Project general facts

Yas Park Place is a contemporary residential community, designed as a collection of six mid-rise buildings set within a vibrant landscape of greenery and open spaces. The project brings together modern architecture and nature, creating a living environment where landscaped gardens, pedestrian pathways, and communal areas form an integral part of everyday life. Positioned within close proximity to the island’s key attractions and waterfront, the development offers a balanced lifestyle that combines urban convenience with a calm, park-inspired setting.

The project features a wide range of thoughtfully curated amenities aimed at enhancing residents’ daily experience. These include multiple swimming pools such as an adults-only infinity pool, family pool, and kids’ pool with splash areas, alongside wellness gardens, a fully equipped gym, yoga spaces, and landscaped walking trails. Residents can also enjoy indoor and outdoor co-working areas, a multi-purpose room, outdoor cinema, and dedicated children’s play zones. Additional lifestyle elements include retail and dining outlets, community pavilions, dog parks with designated walking paths, and comprehensive services such as 24/7 security, maintenance, and concierge support.

Interiors at Yas Park Place are designed with a focus on refined simplicity and functionality, featuring high-quality, durable materials throughout. Living areas, bedrooms, and bathrooms are finished with porcelain floor tiles, complemented by painted walls and ceilings in a clean, modern palette. Kitchens are fitted with laminate cabinetry for both upper and lower units, paired with engineered stone countertops and backsplashes, while bathrooms incorporate porcelain accent tiles, glass shower partitions, and brushed nickel sanitaryware. Doors are finished in laminate, and wardrobes follow a cohesive material scheme, creating a consistent and contemporary interior aesthetic across all residences.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, is a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim. This man-made island covers approximately 9.6 square kilometers (3.7 square miles) and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. One of its highlights is the renowned Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

At the heart of Yas Island is Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer. This extraordinary park enthralls visitors with its thrilling rides, including the record-breaking Formula Rossa roller coaster that accelerates to speeds of up to 240 kilometers per hour (149 miles per hour). Ferrari World also presents captivating exhibits showcasing the brand's history and heritage.

Yas Island's aquatic paradise, Yas Waterworld, offers a refreshing escape from the desert heat. Packed with exhilarating water slides, rides, and pools suitable for all ages, this water park is a must-visit for families and adventure-seekers. Yas Waterworld incorporates Emirati culture and traditions into its design, creating a one-of-a-kind experience that showcases the region's rich heritage.
